extracted.intended_audience: members of the public, stakeholders, petitioners, and their counsel who wish to submit comments on FAA petitions for exemption (and agency staff drafting/publishing such notices)
extracted.subtask_description: Procedural requirements and drafting elements for a Federal Register summary notice of an FAA petition for exemption, including how to submit public comments, what must be included in the petition summary, and where to access the docket.

rubrics_metrics.name: Comment identification and deadline
rubrics_metrics.description: Comments on this petition must identify the petition docket number and must be received on or before February 23, 2026.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Comments must reference docket number FAA-2025-5799. Adhere strictly to the stated closing date; late comments may not be considered.

rubrics_metrics.name: Methods of submitting comments
rubrics_metrics.description: Send comments identified by docket number FAA-2025-5799 using any of the following methods: Federal eRulemaking Portal (http://www.regulations.gov), mail to Docket Operations (address provided), hand delivery or courier to Docket Operations (address provided; between 9 a.m. and 5 p.m., M–F), or fax to (202) 493-2251.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: When using the Federal eRulemaking Portal, 'go to http://www.regulations.gov and follow the online instructions for sending your comments electronically.' For in-person filings, observe the stated office location and hours.

rubrics_metrics.name: Privacy and public posting of comments
rubrics_metrics.description: In accordance with 5 U.S.C. 553(c), DOT solicits comments from the public to better inform its rulemaking process. DOT posts these comments, without edit, including any personal information the commenter provides, to http://www.regulations.gov, as described in the system of records notice (DOT/ALL-14 FDMS).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Agencies review submissions and may choose to redact or withhold certain submissions (or portions). Submitted comments may not be available to be read until the agency has approved them. Review the DOT privacy notice (http://www.dot.gov/privacy) for details.

rubrics_metrics.name: Docket access and inspection
rubrics_metrics.description: Background documents or comments received may be read at http://www.regulations.gov at any time.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Alternatively, visit Docket Operations in Room W12-140, West Building Ground Floor, 1200 New Jersey Avenue SE, Washington, DC 20590-0001, between 9 a.m. and 5 p.m., Monday through Friday, except Federal holidays. Follow online instructions for accessing the docket.

rubrics_metrics.name: Required elements of a petition summary notice
rubrics_metrics.description: A summary notice of a petition for exemption includes the docket number, petitioner name, sections of 14 CFR affected, and a description of the relief sought.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Example: This notice identifies 'Trident Adventures, Inc. dba Trident Adventures' as petitioner; lists affected sections (§§ 91.108(b)(1) and 91.108(b)(2)); and describes the relief sought (limited intentional release of passenger seatbelts during stabilized helicopter hover over open water for Helo Cast operations). Notices are published to improve public awareness and participation in the FAA exemption process.

rubrics_metrics.name: Citation of governing authority for petition publication
rubrics_metrics.description: This notice is published pursuant to 14 CFR 11.85.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Petitions for exemption and their publication should conform to the procedural requirements set out in Part 11 (e.g., 14 CFR 11.85). The notice may include FR document number, publication date, and billing code.

rubrics_metrics.name: Document headings and metadata to include
rubrics_metrics.description: Document headings vary by document but may contain the agency or agencies that issued and signed a document; the number of the CFR title and the number of each part the document amends, proposes to amend, or is directly related to; the agency docket number / agency internal file number; and the RIN which identifies each regulatory action.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: See the Document Drafting Handbook for more details on required headings and metadata; include consistent docket identifiers and citation (e.g., '91 FR 5020', 'Document Number 2026-02162').

rubrics_metrics.name: Legal status and verification disclaimer
rubrics_metrics.description: The online XML prototype of the Federal Register is not an official legal edition and does not replace the official print version or the official electronic version on govinfo.gov. The XML rendition on FederalRegister.gov does not provide legal notice to the public or judicial notice to the courts.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Users relying on the site for legal research should verify their results against an official edition of the Federal Register (official PDFs on govinfo.gov). Only official editions provide legal notice under 44 U.S.C. 1503 & 1507.
